# Chaplain
The Chaplain is an Imperium support role. His strength isn't in guns, but in the [color=#a4885c]Sacred Dash[/color], healing and reflecting projectiles.
## Abilities - [color=#a4885c]Sacred Dash[/color] — a leap across the room that cuts down everyone in the path and knocks enemies off their feet. Perfect for breaking through a melee line to reach the shooters. - [color=#a4885c]Bible healing[/color] — hitting an ally with the bible heals them. Yes, that's how medicine works in the Imperium. - [color=#a4885c]Projectile reflection[/color] — the Chaplain reflects some of the projectiles flying at him back into the shooters.
## Restrictions - [color=#ff0000]The Chaplain cannot fire firearms[/color] — it's against his faith. Don't try to hand him a lasgun. - Your arsenal is the dash, the bible and reflection. Nothing else.
## When to use the dash - Breaking through an enemy melee line to their shooters — the dash clears a corridor. - The dash takes a long time to recharge, so don't waste it on lone targets.
## Role requirements - Requires experience as a sergeant and a guardsman; race must be Human (not T'au). - Gear: robe, bible, inquisition shoulder piece, chaplain dog tag.
